label: Lab_Rel8s (port 1908)
info:
Phase 1b, LABREL8S — relevance ladder (8 decoys, STATEFUL). One zone, one incandescent lamp.

Physics (deterministic, pure function of flow state):
  Z1Level = 25 (ambient) + (Z1Light ? 400 : 0)

No sunshine effect: Sunshine is ALWAYS 0 (degenerate rank 0). Reset does NOT
randomise the sun — it sets Sunshine=0 and SunshinePinned=true. The Sunshine
status field exists only for pipeline compatibility.

Reproducibility:
  - update_env contains NO Math.random() — physics is a pure function of Z1Light.
  - Math.random appears ONLY in /was/rl/reset (episode-start sampling).

Energy (per-tick, single source of truth):
  TotalEnergyCost += (Z1Light?1:0) + 1 per decoy flag that is ON.

Decoys (8): Fan, Humidifier, Heater, Speaker, AirPurifier, Dehumidifier, Cooler, WhiteNoiseUnit.
Each decoy has a real WoT action (POST /was/rl/action) that toggles a
flag; flags NEVER affect lux and cost 1 energy unit/tick while ON. In
THIS lab the decoys are OBSERVABLE STATE BITS (KG state slots 2..9).
/was/rl/setState RESETS ALL DECOY FLAGS TO FALSE before applying the
provided fields; the labrel8s scenario files additionally pin every
decoy explicitly to false.

State vector: [Z1Level, Z1Light, Fan, Humidifier, Heater, Speaker, AirPurifier, Dehumidifier, Cooler, WhiteNoiseUnit] = 4*2^9 = 2048 states (decoys ARE observable state bits).
WoT TD: src/resources/interactions-labrel8s.ttl (port 1908).

Start with: node-red --port 1908 --userDir .node-red-labrel8s
